label: D2 after a1 led rarely to S2 (early episode); weaker GO after an unrewarded S2 trial
explanation: Never fires at D1 or on rewarded-input steps, and essentially never after episode trial ~50 (strong decay with ep_trial: rate 12% in trials 0-9, 0 from 50 on). All D2 activations (68% of mass) are on the a1 -> S2 rare transition (in_action=1, in_state=2); it never fires at D2 for S1 or after a2. Restricted to ep_trial<50 this predicate has dev P=0.83, R=0.57, mass recall 0.68. The remaining ~32% of mass is weaker GO-phase firing, mostly after an unrewarded previous trial (in_rew=0, often prev_state=S2); adding that clause raises dev mass recall to 0.93 but drops precision to 0.30, so it was not recorded. Magnitude is larger at D2 than GO and the top activations are D2 a1->S2R steps and GO steps after unrewarded trials early in the episode. All variables used are observed at the step (ep_trial is not an input but the time-in-episode drift is internal).
